acceptance_rules: Accept a candidate exact DOB when at least one verified Tier A independence group supports it and no unresolved trusted exact-date conflict exists.
Accept a candidate exact DOB when at least two verified, independent Tier B groups support it and no unresolved trusted exact-date conflict exists.

An official Leopoldina new-member profile exact DOB is Tier A. It may accept a same-slug, same-name, same-date candidate or create an official-only accepted record. A date mismatch is never merged automatically.
Manually adjudicated conflicts override the generic conflict hold only for the explicitly frozen person and date.
Copied, locator-only, Wikipedia/DBpedia-derived, or non-independent content never creates an evidence group.
Language versions and mirrors within one content family count as one independence group.
conflict_override_rule: Any non-adjudicated trusted exact-date conflict blocks acceptance regardless of tier.
archive_exception_rule: A manually verified official page blocked by HTTP 403 may be retained as an explicit archive exception; it must never be represented as locally archived raw content.
